newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic blood oxygenator approved for marketing.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic blood oxygenator approved for marketing.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Wednesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved its Maxima Forte blood oxygenator for marketing.
Shipments to open-heart surgical centers worldwide will begin immediately.

Medtronic said its Maxima Forte device succeeds the Medtronic Maxima oxygenator, which has played the role of the lungs in more than 1.6 million surgical operations where the blood has been routed through a perfusion circuit outside the body. This circuit is composed of several individual devices that pump and oxygenate the blood, regulate its temperature, monitor its oxygen level, and hold some of it for reinfusion if needed.
The perfusion circuit is commonly used in coronary artery bypass and other major surgical procedures where the heart must be relieved of its pumping function while repairs are made.
Shares of Medtronic, a medical device manufacturer, were trading up 5/8 to 69-5/8.
